label: Maintenance → Unified Namespace
info:
Reads the (simulated) ERP's maintenance CSV export and republishes each functional location's most recent work order into the plant's MQTT namespace, under a "maintenance" domain keyed by functional location.

The CSV lives at /data/exports/workorders.csv (mounted read-only from the same host folder the simulator writes to). It only ever grows — one row is appended the moment a work order is created in the Maintenance HMI (http://localhost:8090/maint), never on later status changes.

Each functional location gets ONE retained topic, .../LatestWorkOrder, holding whichever order was created there most recently — not one topic per order. Creating a second order at the same location overwrites the first's topic.

Flow: poll → read whole file → parse rows → keep only the latest order per functional location, and only if it's changed since last publish → build the namespace topic + payload → publish.

name: 1. Poll the ERP export and read the whole CSV
2. Keep the latest order per functional location, then "grep" out ones already published
Keep only the latest order per location
Build UNS topic + payload

label: Quality → Unified Namespace
info:
Reads the (simulated) LIMS's lab-sample CSV export and republishes each newly-registered Proofing result into the plant's MQTT namespace, under a "quality" domain.

The CSV lives at /data/exports/lab_samples.csv (mounted read-only from the same host folder the simulator writes to). It only ever grows — one row is appended the moment a technician registers a result in the Lab HMI (http://localhost:8090/lab), for either stage (Proofing or Oven); this flow only handles Proofing so far.

Each result publishes three retained topics under .../Quality/WaffleLine01/Proofing/: two individual current-value tags (DoughCoreTemperature, DoughPh) and one LatestSample tag carrying the whole record as JSON. A later Oven-stage branch would follow the same shape.

Flow: poll → read whole file → parse rows → keep only Proofing rows not seen before → fan out to the 3 topics + payloads → publish.

name: 1. Poll the LIMS export and read the whole CSV
2. Parse rows, keep only Proofing, then "grep" out ones already published
Keep only new Proofing sample_ids
3. Fan out to 3 topics: two point values + the whole sample as LatestSample
Build UNS topics + payloads
